items.name: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover
items.one_liner: Strip AI watermarks and metadata from any file format
items.pain_point: Content creators and businesses need clean, provenance-free AI assets for commercial reuse, but manually removing C2PA/metadata is tedious and error-prone
app_ideas: Browser extension: one-click watermark strip for images/documents on any webpage
Batch processing SaaS: drag-drop interface for agencies cleaning AI assets before client delivery
API wrapper service: developer-facing endpoint with format detection, processing, and clean export
items.monetization: Freemium API wrapper with tiered rate limits + B2B enterprise contracts for agencies needing compliance-grade stripping
items.why_now: C2PA adoption accelerating, AI content labeling mandates growing globally, and this repo just hit 32% weekly star growth indicating explosive demand
